assertions.assertion: The denial carries reason code CO-197.
CPT 93229 corresponds to Mobile Cardiac Telemetry.
The payer letter attributes the denial to precertification not being obtained before the service was rendered.
The patient has recurrent episodes of palpitations.
The patient has known paroxysmal atrial fibrillation.
Paroxysmal atrial fibrillation is coded as I48.0 and I48.91.
The patient has atherosclerotic heart disease.
Atherosclerotic heart disease is coded as I25.10.
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to correlate symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias.
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to assess the efficacy of current rate control management.
The documentation supports the medical necessity of CPT 93229.
